description: This file defines the PdfName class, which represents a name object within a PDF document. It includes constructors, equality operations, string manipulation methods specifically for handling PDF names (which must start with a slash), and internal methods for writing the object to a PDF stream, as well as a comparer class.

classes.name: PdfName
classes.description: Represents a PDF name value, providing mechanisms for creation, comparison, and string manipulation. Ensures names start with a slash and supports equality operators.

classes.name: PdfXNameComparer
classes.description: Provides a comparer for PdfName objects based on ordinal string comparison.

methods.name: PdfName()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the name to a slash indicating an empty name.

methods.name: PdfName(string value)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the name with a string, which must start with a slash.

methods.name: Equals(object? obj)
methods.description: Checks equality with another PdfName or string.

methods.name: GetHashCode()
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the name value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the name, always beginning with a slash.

methods.name: AddSlash(string value)
methods.description: Ensures the string begins with a slash, adding one if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveSlash(string value)
methods.description: Removes the leading slash from a string if present.

methods.name: FromString(string value)
methods.description: Creates a PdfName from a string that should not start with a slash; adds one if necessary.
